name: aircursor
description: Transparent macOS hand and voice control overlay.
author: starlight-glimeer

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check public/dashboard.js && node --check public/overlay.js && node --check public/pose.js && node --check public/tracking.js

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: AirCursor uses the camera to recognize your hand gestures.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AirCursor uses the microphone for optional voice commands.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: AirCursor uses speech recognition for optional local voice commands.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: AirCursor uses local automation to launch apps you request.
